This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Messenger" />

==Biology and appearance==
This tall bipedal [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their lanky frames, [[Color|pale blue]] and pink skin, and elongated [[Bone|horns]].<ref name="Messenger" />

==Species in the galaxy==
By [[2 BBY]], a member of this species was present at the [[Imperial Senate Building]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]],<ref name="Messenger" /> witnessing [[Mon Mothma]]'s [[Escape from the Senate|escape from the Senate]].<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion">{{Andor|Welcome to the Rebellion}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Unidentified-Tall-Horns-Species-Concept.jpg|right|250px|thumb|PILGRIM+sketch+06e by Tom Blake.]]
The species made their debut in the [[Messenger|seventh episode]] of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'',<ref name="Messenger" /> directed by [[Janus Metz]] and aired on [[May 6]], [[2025]]<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref> The species was originally designed by [[Tom Blake]].<ref name="Portfolio">{{WebCite|url=https://www.tomblakedesign.com/design/andor2|text=TOM BLAKE DESIGN ANIMATRONICS Project : STAR WARS ANDOR SEASON 2 Task : Creature Concept Design Studio : Neal Scanlan Studio Lucasfilm |work=[https://www.tomblakedesign.com TOM BLAKE DESIGN ANIMATRONICS]|archivedate=20250622232021}}</ref>
